risks.risk: The laptop may not be a 2016 model, or may be a different generation (e.g., 2015 or 2017) with different specs.
risks.proof: Photo of the model number label on the bottom of the laptop (usually near the hinge or battery area) or a screenshot of System Report (About This Mac > System Report).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic MacBook Pro without year, which may be lower than 2016 model value.

risks.risk: The CPU, RAM, and SSD specifications may not match the seller's claims.
risks.proof: Screenshot of 'About This Mac' showing processor, memory, and storage details.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if specs are not confirmed, which may be lower than advertised value.

risks.risk: The laptop may have physical damage not visible in photos, such as screen cracks, hinge issues, or internal damage.
risks.proof: Video showing the laptop opening and closing, screen flex test, and close-up of the screen and keyboard.
risks.if_unproven: Priced with assumption of minor wear only, but potential for hidden damage reduces value.

risks.risk: The laptop may have been restored or have a non-original SSD or RAM, affecting performance and warranty.
risks.proof: Screenshot of System Report showing serial number and hardware details, and possibly a verification of SSD health via Disk Utility.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if original components, but may be lower if non-original or degraded.
